parsed_response.explanation: The agent correctly identified the number of children who did not survive, but then incorrectly concluded that this meant 'not all children under 18 survived' when the question was 'Did any children below the age of 18 survive?'. The presence of even one child who did not survive means the answer to the question is 'Yes'.
parsed_response.evidence: The question was 'Did any children below the age of 18 survive?'. The agent found 'Number of children under 18 who did not survive: 64'. The agent then reasoned 'Since there are 64 children under the age of 18 who did not survive, this means that not all children under 18 survived.' and provided 'final_answer("No")'.
